class.name: AttackBase
class.brief_description: [color=green](User creatable)[/color] A class for attack patterns in the UT-Godot-Engine battle system. All attack patterns inherit from this class and provide functionality for bullet creation, placement, masking, and more.
class.description:
[b]AttackBase[/b] is the core base class for implementing attack patterns in an Undertale-style battle system.
[b]Masking System[/b] • [code]ABSOLUTE_CLIP[/code]: Absolute position + box area clipping • [code]ABSOLUTE[/code]: Absolute position + no clipping • [code]RELATIVE_BOX_CLIP[/code]: Box-relative position + clipping • [code]RELATIVE_BOX[/code]: Box-relative position + no clipping
[b]Example (GDScript)[/b] [codeblock] extends AttackBase
@export var bullet_scene: PackedScene
func ready(): # Initialize attack pattern pass
func start_attack(): # Adjust box size box.change_size(Vector2(300, 200), false, 0.5)
# Create circular bullet pattern var center = box.get_size() / 2 for i in range(8): var angle = (float(i) / 8) * PI * 2.0 var pos = center + Vector2(cos(angle), sin(angle)) * 100 quick_bullet(bullet_scene, pos, rad_to_deg(angle), AttackBase.RELATIVE_BOX_CLIP) await get_tree().create_timer(0.1).timeout
# End attack after 3 seconds await get_tree().create_timer(3.0).timeout end_attack() [/codeblock]
[en] For a more detailed explanation, please refer to the tutorials linked below. [ko] 이것보다 더 자세한 설명(또는 한국어 문서)은 아래 링크된 튜토리얼을 참고하세요.

method.name: ready
method.description: Called when the attack pattern is initialized. Should be used instead of the [method Node._ready] method.

method.name: start_attack
method.description: Function that starts the attack pattern. Can be called by [method AttackManager.start_attack] or [method AttackManager.start_attacks], or called directly. Must call [method end_attack] to terminate the pattern when the pattern ends.

method.name: add_bullet
method.description: A commonly used bullet addition method. Adds the bullet node passed as [param bullet] to the current attack pattern.

method.name: quick_bullet
method.description: Quickly creates and places a bullet scene. [param bullet_scene] is the bullet scene to instantiate. [param pos] is the bullet position, [param rot_deg] is the rotation angle (in degrees). [param mask] determines the rendering method. Returns the created bullet node, or null on failure.

method.name: end_attack
method.description: Ends the attack pattern. Emits the [signal remove_bullets] signal to remove all bullets, and emits the [signal remove_attack] signal to remove itself. All attack patterns must call this method upon completion.

members.member: The unique ID of the attack pattern. Used by [AttackManager] to identify attacks.
Reference to the battle system's main node. Read-only. Used to access battle-related global settings and other components.
Reference to the battle box node. Read-only. Used for changing box size, adjusting position, etc.
Reference to the player soul node. Read-only. Used for checking soul position, changing states, etc.
Reference to the attack manager node. Read-only. Used for starting next attack patterns, managing overall attacks, etc.
Reference to the camera controller node. Read-only. Used for camera shake, zoom, movement effects, etc.

signal.name: remove_attack
signal.description: Emitted when the attack pattern ends and should be removed. [param id] is the [member attack_id] of the attack to be removed. Automatically emitted when [method end_attack] is called.

signal.name: remove_bullets
signal.description: Signal to remove all bullets. Automatically connected and called if bullets have a [code]fade[/code] method. Automatically emitted when [method end_attack] is called.

constants.constant: Places bullets at absolute positions and clips to the box area. Uses absolute screen coordinates, bullets outside the box are not visible. The most commonly used default masking mode.
Places bullets at absolute positions without clipping. Uses absolute screen coordinates, bullets are visible even outside the box.
Places bullets at positions relative to the box and clips them. Bullets move together when the box moves, bullets outside the box are not visible. Suitable for patterns that move with the box.
Places bullets at positions relative to the box without clipping. Bullets move together when the box moves, bullets are visible even outside the box.
